review.comment: clamp returns min/max/value with early returns and prints Result: correctly for the in-range and out-of-range cases, including ERROR: invalid range when min > max. Non-finite input also prints invalid range instead of ERROR: invalid number, and equal min/max is rejected. Next: if any value fails Number.isFinite, print ERROR: invalid number; only if min > max print ERROR: invalid range.

Pass (100): clamp returns min/max/value with early returns and no I/O; main parses three lines, uses Number.isFinite for ERROR: invalid number, rejects inverted ranges, and prints Result: for the clamped value. All acceptance criteria met.
